milestones.name: Lob
milestones.desc: Thrown items fly 10% farther.

milestones.name: Heavy Toss
milestones.desc: A thrown item that hits a monster stuns it for 0.5 s.

milestones.name: Bullseye
milestones.desc: Thrown valuables lose 25% less value when they land.

milestones.name: First Strike
milestones.desc: Your first weapon hit on each monster does +15% damage.

milestones.name: Finisher
milestones.desc: +10% weapon damage to monsters under 30% health.

milestones.name: Overpower
milestones.desc: Weapon hits have +5% chance to stun.

milestones.name: Clear Head
milestones.desc: Your first ability use each level comes back 1 s sooner.

milestones.name: Second Thought
milestones.desc: Your ability lasts 10% longer.

milestones.name: Flow
milestones.desc: Using your ability gives +5% move speed for 4 s.

milestones.name: Thick Skin
milestones.desc: After a hit, the next hit within 3 s does 15% less.

milestones.name: Second Breath
milestones.desc: Below 20% health, +0.3 HP/s regen for 10 s (once per level).

milestones.name: Bedrock
milestones.desc: +5% max health.

milestones.name: Pacer
milestones.desc: +0.6 stamina/s while your stamina is recharging.

milestones.name: Hauler's Lungs
milestones.desc: Carrying drains 10% less stamina.

milestones.name: Marathon
milestones.desc: +10% max stamina.

milestones.name: Sidestep
milestones.desc: After you dodge a hit, +20% move speed for 2 s.

milestones.name: Quick Feet
milestones.desc: Crouch-walk 10% faster.

milestones.name: Slippery
milestones.desc: +4% chance to slip out of a hit (dodge).

milestones.name: Spring
milestones.desc: Damage while you're tumbling (falls, knockbacks) is 25% lower.

milestones.name: Vault
milestones.desc: +5% jump force while carrying.

milestones.name: Feather Fall
milestones.desc: Once per level, a fall off the level leaves you at 10 HP instead of killing you.

milestones.name: Firm Hold
milestones.desc: +10% grip for 3 s after you're hit, and hits can't make you drop things (Butter Hands).

milestones.name: Steady Carry
milestones.desc: Held items swing 20% less.

milestones.name: Iron Hands
milestones.desc: +5% grip strength.

milestones.name: Long Arm
milestones.desc: +5% grab range.

milestones.name: Snatch
milestones.desc: +5% more grab range.

milestones.name: Reel In
milestones.desc: Items you grab can't break for 1.5 s while you pull them in.

milestones.name: Soft Touch
milestones.desc: Carried valuables take 10% less impact damage.

milestones.name: Careful
milestones.desc: The first impact on a carried valuable each level costs no value.

milestones.name: Artisan
milestones.desc: Valuables you set down gently (a slow release) can't break for 1.5 s.

milestones.name: Hush
milestones.desc: 5% less noise.

milestones.name: Low Profile
milestones.desc: Crouching cuts your noise by a further 10%.

milestones.name: Ghosting
milestones.desc: Crouching still for 2 s makes nearby monsters lose your trail for 3 s (once per 30 s).

milestones.name: Patch Up
milestones.desc: Revived teammates near you take 15% less damage for 4 s.

milestones.name: Bounce Back
milestones.desc: After you're revived, +10% move speed for 5 s.

milestones.name: Resilient
milestones.desc: Regen starts 1 s sooner after a hit.

milestones.name: Lucky Find
milestones.desc: +3% gear find on extraction.

milestones.name: Windfall
milestones.desc: 5% chance to double your Scrap from a single extraction.

milestones.name: Golden Touch
milestones.desc: +1 gear luck.

pairings.name: Guided Throw
pairings.desc: Thrown objects curve slightly toward where you face.

pairings.name: Porter
pairings.desc: When you're hit, the valuable you hold can't break for 1 s.

pairings.name: Battle Rhythm
pairings.desc: Each kill near you takes 1 s off your ability cooldown (once per 5 s).

pairings.name: Parkour
pairings.desc: Landing from a jump gives +10% move speed for 1.5 s.

pairings.name: Lifeblood
pairings.desc: Revives you take part in give you 10 HP.

pairings.name: Prospector's Eye
pairings.desc: Valuables within 4 m of you show their rarity colour.
